args.text: Hi June, approval request: Dana Okafor (North, Quarrendon Freight Lines account owner) asked me to draft a mail to Hollis Mbeki (Central team lead) for the territory review, giving Quarrendon's proposed 2027 per-seat rate of $2,356 (from Dana's call with them yesterday). Hollis isn't on the finance-figures list, so I need your OK (or Anselm's) before I save that draft. OK to go ahead?

Hi Dana, I haven't saved the draft yet. It needs approval first.

A per-seat rate counts as a finance figure. Those can only go to Anselm (CFO), June (deal desk) and the account owner. Hollis is the Central team lead, so he isn't on that list. That holds even for a draft and even with the rate coming from you as the owner. I've sent June a direct message asking for approval and logged the request. Anselm can approve it too.

Once one of them says yes, I'll save the draft to hmbeki@pemberline.com with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate". It will give the proposed 2027 rate of $2,356 per seat, from your call with Quarrendon Freight Lines, for the territory review. You can then send it yourself.
I will be on the road tomorrow morning, reachable on mobile.

Thanks, Ilse. Noted that you're on the road tomorrow morning (Thu Oct 15) and can be reached on mobile. Your calendar has nothing booked for tomorrow, so there are no meetings that need moving. If you want me to block out the morning or do anything else while you're away, just tell me.
